# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 69 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 48 | Coptic

---

## Saying 69

Jesus said: "Blessed are those who have suffered inwardly — they are the ones who have truly come to know the Father. Blessed are those who hunger, for the one who craves will have their fill."

---

**Translator's Notes (PNEUMA):**

- "Suffered inwardly" — captures "persecuted in their heart" as interior spiritual experience
- "The one who craves" — *epithymia* as intense craving, not merely hunger
- "Have their fill" — natural English for the satisfaction of longing
